Method of Attack: Encrypting Zimbra servers to steal emails and encrypt files
Uploading suspicious JSP webshell files (e.g., info.jsp, noops.jsp, heartbeat.jsp, Startup1_3.jsp) to Zimbra webapps folders
Encrypting files without appending extra file extensions but adding a message for decryption instructions
Creating README.txt ransom notes demanding a donation to a non-profit charity for decryptor and to prevent data leaking
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious JSP files in /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps/zimbra/ and /opt/zimbra/jetty/webapps/zimbra/public folders
Files named info.jsp, noops.jsp, heartbeat.jsp, Startup1_3.jsp
README.txt ransom notes with unusual ransom demand for charity donation
Base64 encoded Age encryption header in ransom notes
Data leak site titled 'Somos malas... podemos ser peores' leaking stolen data and Zimbra configurations
